items.docs: Creates an authenticated API session by supplying valid SQL username and password credentials. Returns a session token in the X-Cockroach-API-Session response header. This token must be included as the X-Cockroach-API-Session header on all subsequent requests to authenticated endpoints.
Terminates a previously established API session, invalidating the session token. The X-Cockroach-API-Session header must be included with the session token to revoke.
